# Extended laboratory observations {#sec-extended-lab-observations}

These extended observations are canonical appendix content selected only by
the online supplement profile. An author can move this source into a full
edition, or include it in several compatible editions, without maintaining a
second copy of the prose.

## Supplemental data contract

- Store the source beside ordinary appendices as backend-neutral Markdown.
- Declare exceptional availability in document metadata.
- Select the source from an edition profile rather than conditionalizing each
  paragraph.
- Keep links, media, alternatives, and citations portable even when the first
  published edition is web-only.

This fixture intentionally contains no information required to understand the
default book. Optional material may expand an example, but omission must not
silently remove prerequisites, safety instructions, definitions, or the only
accessible explanation of another artifact.
